products.name: SharePoint Online External Sharing & Access Governance — Commercial
products.short_description: Govern SharePoint/OneDrive external sharing & access — tenant + site settings, link defaults/expiration, allow/block domains, sensitivity controls, guest reviews, and exposure reporting — so sharing is enabled but controlled. products.description:
Control external sharing in SharePoint and OneDrive without blocking work

External sharing in SharePoint/OneDrive drives collaboration and data leakage in equal measure. This solution governs external sharing and access: tenant and site-level sharing settings, sharing-link defaults and expiration, allow/block domains, sensitivity-label-driven controls, guest access and access reviews, and reporting on external exposure — so sharing is enabled but controlled and auditable.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the sharing model: tenant vs site sharing, link types + defaults + expiration, allow/block, sensitivity-driven controls, guests, and exposure reporting.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (SPO admin + Entra, data-classification/sensitivity posture, stakeholders).
  • Implementation Guide — set tenant + site sharing, link defaults + expiration, allow/block domains, sensitivity-driven controls, guest access reviews, and stand up external-exposure reporting — pilot-first, each setting named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (sharing scoped to policy, external exposure visible, stale access reviewed) plus Best Practices for safe external sharing.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

External sharing enabled and controlled — tenant and site settings scoped, links defaulted and expiring, exposure reported, stale access reviewed — collaboration without leakage.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SPOEXT-Discovery.ps1 — read-only SharePoint Online / OneDrive external-sharing posture + exposure baseline. Makes NO changes
    • SPOEXT-ExposureReport.ps1 — read-only external-exposure report: sharing links + external principals across the sites in scope. Makes NO changes
    • SPOEXT-Scope.ps1 — read-only readiness/health check: modules, connections, cloud, and pilot-scope resolution. Makes NO changes
    • SPOEXT-Set-Sharing.ps1 — apply the tenant sharing baseline and/or tighten site-level sharing. SAFE BY DEFAULT: dry-run/-WhatIf unless -Commit
    • SPOEXT-Validation.ps1 — read-only PASS/FAIL check of the sharing baseline against the expected policy. Makes NO changes

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
